# Foundation contract baseline

Pinned canonical contract artifact used only for compile-time/integration compatibility checks.

- LegitPlatform API: `0.1.2-dev.6`
- NetworkCore baseline: `hotfix.45`
- System baseline: `hotfix.50`
- Panel Gateway baseline: `0.1.0-dev.19`

The Assistant security domain does not depend on NetworkCore implementation classes. External authority is consumed through ports and adapters.
